verdict.rationale: The only admin-level evidence is the Enterprise plan doc. It lists org security features, namely audit logs capturing user actions and data access, plus a Compliance API for programmatic access to activity logs, chats and files. It also references a Team plan that Enterprise builds on. These are org-level governance controls but only touch the story glancingly. Missing for 10: documented member invite/removal and role management, permission/access controls, admin-set data policies (retention, model-training opt-out at org level), SSO/provisioning, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
